`speech.ogg` is an 11-second public-domain clip of John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural
address ("ask not what your country can do for you..."), re-encoded to Opus from
`samples/jfk.wav` in [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp). The other test
fixtures (images, a sine tone) are generated with ffmpeg when the tests run.
